newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Ahmsa raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ahmsa raised to buy.

text.p: Mexican brokerage Accival raised its recommendation on steel-maker Ahmsa to buy from neutral, the brokerage said Monday in a statement.

"We expect 1998 to be a more favorable year than 1997 because of cost savings, the normalization of operations, and a lesser appreciation of the peso," analysts Arturo Espinosa and Rafael Urquia wrote in a report.
The brokerage estimated earnings per share for 1997 at 5.32 pesos in 1997 and 11.29 pesos for 1998.
The analysts said Ahmsa has improved its debt profible in recent months and is undervalued with respect to comparable U.S. steel companies.
Ahmsa's shares in Mexico stood at 18.12 pesos in afternoon trading, down 26 centavos from Friday's close.
